items.headline: Cal QB Sagapolutele pulled from loss to UNLV after hit to head
items.description: Cal quarterback Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele exited the Bears' 39-31 road loss to UNLV after a hit to the head and was held out of the rest of the game as a precaution, coach Tosh Lupoi said Saturday.

items.headline: Jackson Arnold accounts for 5 TDs as UNLV beats California 39-31
items.description: — Jackson Arnold passed and ran for 287 yards and five touchdowns to lead UNLV to a 39-31 victory over short-handed California on Saturday.
